description: Na₃U₂H₅(Se₂O₉)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one Na₃U₂H₅(Se₂O₉)₂ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid and edges with three NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.89 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid and edges with three NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent U sites. In the first U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 63°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.58 Å. In the second U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.57 Å. There are five inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.04 Å) and one longer (1.52 Å) H-O bond length. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.05 Å) and one longer (1.52 Å) H-O bond length. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are four inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.76 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.78 Å. In the third Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.77 Å. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.75 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one U atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one U atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one U, two H, and one Se atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one U and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one U and one Se atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two U and one Se atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two U, and one Se atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaU₂Se trigonal pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one U and one Se atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one U and one Se atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one U, one H, and one Se atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Se tetrahedra. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Se atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Se atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Se atom to form distorted ONa₃Se tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃Se tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONaU₂Se trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Se tetrahedra. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three H atoms.
